title: Blind SSRF (URL in JSON request body)
remediation: Do not let user input drive server-side fetches. Enforce an allowlist of permitted hosts and schemes, block internal/link-local ranges and the cloud metadata endpoint, disable unneeded URL schemes (gopher/dict/ftp/file), resolve-then-pin the destination to defeat DNS rebinding, and never follow redirects into internal space. The inbound callback proves a server-side fetch fired.
